provenance.x11_to_hid: Bergmann89/msi-perkeyrgb fork, the ['GS66'] table (MIT): the GS65 table plus the power key's RGB element at HID 102 in the numpad region.
provenance.validated: Not lit by this plugin yet. The GS66 12U ships the same KLC with USB id 1038:113a; another Omarchy plugin (omarchy-keyboard-rgb) drives it with the GE75 table and reports the power key LED as addressable.

notes.power: The power button carries an RGB element. Its separate GPU-status LED is firmware-driven and not addressable.
